catalysts.headline: Positive preliminary Phase 2 topline data for rademikibart in acute asthma exacerbations -- statistically significant FEV1 improvement at Day 7 vs placebo and ~66% reduction in 28-day treatment failures (the treatment-failure endpoint itself did not reach statistical significance; safety profile was clean)

Lead candidate rademikibart failed to meet the primary endpoint in a Phase 2 asthma trial; the company's own release emphasized positive secondary findings (66% reduction in treatment failure, FEV1 improvement), but the stock reaction indicates the primary-endpoint miss dominated investor reaction
